apps.short_description: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

apps.name: 687 Days on Mars - First Steps
apps.short_description: Take your first steps on Mars and face the challenge of surviving alone on the Red Planet. Build your first shelter, secure vital resources, grow food, research new technologies, and explore the hostile Martian landscape. Your survival starts here.

apps.name: 8bit Salvage
apps.short_description: Scrub old game art. Save the pixels. Clean through chaos. A calm, oddly satisfying incremental cleaning game that ends in a glorious storm. Then step onto Bob's roguelite game show, where the odds are odd.

apps.name: A Journey's End
apps.short_description: A boy wakes up in the spirit world not knowing how he got there. He needs to find a way home but is caught up working for the owner of the bath house. Forced to work, he must find a way to escape the bath house, and find his way back home before the spirit feast festival arrives

apps.name: A Mission Full of Cats
apps.short_description: A Mission Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you help Fofiño bring all the cats back to Gattaca! This intergalactic vacation is coming to an end, and it's time to track down all the cats scattered across the universe!

apps.name: A Personal Winter
apps.short_description: A short visual novel about a boy and his senpai spending a night together in a snow-covered city.

apps.name: Above Water, Below Hell
apps.short_description: Fight your way through a zombie-infested high-rise in flooded Chicago. Inspect survivors, track their symptoms, and lead them to safety in this first-person horror shooter. Fortify your route and protect your group. One missed infection can turn a rescue into a massacre.

apps.name: Above Water, Below Hell - Prologue
apps.short_description: Fight your way through four zombie‑infested floors of a high‑rise in flooded Chicago. Inspect survivors, track their symptoms, and lead them to safety in this first-person horror shooter. Fortify your route and protect your group. One missed infection can turn a rescue into a massacre.

apps.name: Academy Anomaly
apps.short_description: An online co-op horror game for 2–4 players. Check the task list, retrieve the required items, eliminate anomalies with the A.C.T., and survive the enemies to escape.

apps.name: Aevalore 2
apps.short_description: Fight through the world of Aevalore II, a fast action roguelike. Pick your hero, build your skills, defeat giant bosses, and survive alone or with friends in online co-op

apps.name: Age of Cores
apps.short_description: Configure your ships, set their combat behaviors, and launch into procedural space missions! A tactical roguelite where you balance risk and reward: gather resources to upgrade your mothership, unlock tech trees, master active skills, and build the ultimate fleet.

apps.name: Airport 7
apps.short_description: You are trapped in an endless airport terminal. Observe your surroundings carefully, find the anomalies, and find your way out.

apps.name: Alien Resource Manager
apps.short_description: Job simulation can be a lot of fun if you hire aliens for the Galactic Huge IT Company! Build your career through corporate chaos and remember - keep the budget in the green at all times!

apps.name: Ambience
apps.short_description: Ambience is a first-person spatial puzzle, where you combine lights and colors to access new dimensions and shape the minimalistic world around you.

apps.name: Animula Nook
apps.short_description: Shrink down and reimagine your desk as a whimsical world in Animula Nook, a cozy miniature life sim. Craft your homes from odds and ends, grow giant crops, style your OOTD, and explore the enchanting Wupa Woods. Just remember, Minies are always by your side.

apps.name: Anomaly Cafe
apps.short_description: Manage a quaint coffee shop hidden deep in an unknown forest. Brew daily cups for ordinary travelers, but be prepared to adapt your service when unusual and anomalous entities start lining up for their caffeine fix.

apps.name: AREA 51: The Awakening
apps.short_description: A dark, sci-fi, indie horror. The protagonist, Chris, wants to find his father, a scientist at Area 51 who has disappeared. He and his friends plan to infiltrate Area 51 and find his father. But the secrets and horrors of the place await them there...

apps.name: AscendiA
apps.short_description: Ever dreamed of being a shonen manga hero? Ascendia is a pixel-art action roguelike where hidden Easter eggs grant special powers called Astra, and secret classes await discovery. Uncover secrets to grow stronger, and let your choices and actions shape your ending. Your awakening starts here.

apps.name: Asteroid Forge
apps.short_description: An arcade asteroid shooter with an incremental heart. Break rocks and watch the numbers climb, but nothing you mine is yours until you fly home and extract it. Die out there and half your cargo stays behind.

apps.name: Astonishia Story
apps.short_description: Relive this retro-styled RPG classic with refined visuals and other enhancements! The time has come to recover a stolen relic and your honor.

apps.name: Auriga
apps.short_description: In 1988 the rover AURIGA found something on Mars, and the program buried it. 350 years later, it wakes. Drive a slow, physical rover across procedurally generated worlds: drill, scan, map caves with lidar and outlast radiation, storms and crushing air, from green-phosphor Mars to distant stars.

apps.name: Bar Owner Simulator
apps.short_description: Take over a small neighborhood bar and turn it into a thriving nightlife venue. Mix cocktails, serve customers, manage stock, add pool and karaoke, upgrade your bar, and handle the chaos of every busy night.

apps.name: Barbie™ Rewind
apps.short_description: Decorate the DreamHouse™ through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie™ Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.

apps.name: Barely Developers
apps.short_description: Start a game studio in your mom's garage! Create hit games, design your own consoles, hire unpredictable employees, and build your way from broke indie developer to AAA powerhouse. Play solo or with up to 3 friends, just don't let Mom pull the plug.

apps.name: Basement To The Sky
apps.short_description: A bright afternoon, perfect weather. With your parents away, you’re left with a rocket toy you received as a birthday gift. Build your own rocket and launch it high into the sky! Enjoy delicious homemade meals and work part-time jobs to upgrade your rocket. Can your rocket reach outer space?

apps.name: Battle Swap
apps.short_description: Battle Swap is an auto-battler with a single player campaign and a unique twist: when you win a battle, you trade your deployed units for your enemy’s, rewarding you for using fewer units. Unlock upgrades, items, and spells as you go, and revisit past battles to improve solutions and reclaim units.

apps.name: Battle-Lines
apps.short_description: Like playing Go with puzzle pieces. Build, recolor and steal lines to dominate the board! Play local, online or against AI.

apps.name: BEARBRICK HEROES
apps.short_description: Run, jump, and race your way to the finish together! Create your own missions, collect a variety of BE@RBRICK(BEARBRICK), and explore a growing MMORPG world filled with adventure. Play, create, and connect your way. LET'S PLAY & CONNECT!

apps.name: BedWars MOBA
apps.short_description: BedWars reimagined from a top-down perspective! Collect resources, buy powerful items, build bridges, defend your bed and destroy enemy beds in fast-paced multiplayer battles. Discover unique items, outsmart your opponents and fight to be the last team standing!

apps.name: Beezarr
apps.short_description: Swarms of ants, spiders, and wasps are closing in — fight back with stingers, honey, and frost! Level up, unleash brutal weapon evolutions, and face 5 massive bosses in this honey‑sweet survivors‑like. For PC & Steam Deck.

apps.name: Beryl
apps.short_description: Team up with up to three friends in a free-to-play action RPG. Build your hero from 720 skills, find rare gear, socket gems into your gear, and fight through 840 kinds of monsters and 14 colossal bosses on ever-harder world difficulties.

apps.name: BFM 26
apps.short_description: Take control of the pitch and the football world. Play full 3D matches, build your dream club, rise through the managerial ranks and lead nations to glory. Experience an incredibly deep career mode with endless seasons, a living football universe and powerful customisation tools.

apps.name: Billion Nails
apps.short_description: There are a billion bent nails outside your house. You have a hammer. In this cozy first-person simulator, earn credits by sinking nails, clear wider patches with better tools, and put machines to work. Watch the clearing grow from your doorstep.

apps.name: Blind Box Party
apps.short_description: A party game of secret choices for 2–8 friends. Every round, take the item in plain sight or gamble on the mystery box. Bid with coins, use secret roles to steal, sabotage and deceive, then vote on who played best. Nobody knows what you picked until the end!

apps.name: Blood Rails
apps.short_description: An armored train, a straight track across a dead continent, and a horde that never stops chasing you. Turn your train into a fortress, loot abandoned villages and decide whether the next kilometer is worth the risk.

apps.name: Bloomwalker
apps.short_description: Travel with a moving house and restore a tainted world in this heartfelt crafting adventure. Build and tend to your own little world beyond the door, and breathe new life into a fallen world alongside the versatile familiars and the spirits known as higgledies.

apps.name: Blu's Honey Days
apps.short_description: Run a cozy little honey shop in this 30-day management game. Choose action cards, manage your money and inventory, serve customers, and make tough decisions to save your shop from closing.

apps.name: Boltz
apps.short_description: Boltz is a minimalist logic puzzle where you try to remove all the target bolts and nuts on the screen. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new mechanics added approximately every 10 levels.

apps.name: BORE
apps.short_description: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.

apps.name: Bountiful Hunters
apps.short_description: Fight by yourself or with friends to survive a gauntlet of enemies in set stages. Collect items to empower your character and take down enemies quicker. Play as multiple different characters with varying play styles. Fight strong bosses that reward you handsomely with more money than normal enemies.

apps.name: Brothel Hotel
apps.short_description: Hi, I’m Jessica, and welcome to Brothel Hotel! This pixel art management game for adults puts you in charge of an exclusive brothel. Your mission? Oversee every aspect of the business, ensure smooth operations, and fulfill the desires of an ever-demanding clientele.

apps.name: Bruisin Cruisers
apps.short_description: Race to save your lunch from the larcenous Jerkwad! Bump, jump, dash and crash through him and his minions in this top-down car-combat smash-a-thon!

apps.name: Building to the Sky
apps.short_description: A tower-building management sim you can read like an architect's drawing. Build a classic side-on 2D tower or a 3D landmark you can slice open floor by floor, run it for thousands of tenants, and switch any time between rendered, blueprint and CAD views.

apps.name: Burning Skies
apps.short_description: Burning Skies is a frantic roguelite bullet hell. Build the ultimate warjet, mix weapons and enhancements every run, take down giant bosses and overthrow the tyrants who rule the world.

apps.name: CalChainVR
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder built on chaining. Match the wind, chain by a gap of one, or pair the same number. Turn your hand into a single chain, and the longer it runs, the harder it hits. 150+ cards, 60+ creations, 50+ skills, in a world leaking through the cracks.

apps.name: Calm Bricks
apps.short_description: Calm Bricks is a cozy brick-building game about the whole ritual: tear open the bags and dig through the pile for that one tiny piece. Follow 3D instructions or free-build in creative mode. No timers, no scores. Just a warm lamp and the click of bricks.

apps.name: Castle In The Darkness 2
apps.short_description: From Matt Kap and Simon Parzer ("The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth"), Castle In The Darkness 2 drops players into a brand-new adventure! Explore a vast world and overcome the darkness in this fun and fast-paced adventure!

apps.name: Chromagami
apps.short_description: Team up with a comrade to fight an interdimensional paper war in this science-fiction, hero shooter.

apps.name: CINDER CITY
apps.short_description:
CINDER CITY is an open-world cinematic third-person shooter set in a fallen near-future Seoul.
Fight alongside allies, push back against overwhelming threats, and reclaim the city from the forces tearing it apart.

apps.name: Click and Shoot!
apps.short_description: Shoot photos to save the team! An adult anime idle clicker with three heroines. Earn funds, upgrade your camera, lighting and props, and unlock 30 outfits plus new poses and adult CGs. Enable auto shooting to keep earning in the background and offline.

apps.name: Clicker Complex: Correcting a Gyaru?!
apps.short_description: Build a flashy fashion empire in this +18 hentai idle clicker where every stylish click and strategic upgrade pushes your bratty gyaru model further. Shape her attitude, stack explosive bonuses, and unlock increasingly daring, chaotic moments as everything spirals out of control.

apps.name: Competition
apps.short_description: Coach a college track & field and cross country program in a shared online world. Recruit athletes, plan their training, enter them in meets and watch them race live against other coaches' teams. Seasons follow the real calendar: one game day is one real day.

apps.name: Contact Protocol
apps.short_description: Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator set aboard a corporate vessel bound for Jupiter. Investigate incoming ships, uncover suspicious activity, and make impossible choices as you protect your crew - while the company watches your every move.

apps.name: Country Economy Simulator
apps.short_description: Govern one of the world's 20 largest economies. Set taxes, split the budget, choose between more State or more Market, and trade with real partners. Every decision has a cost. Can you keep the economy growing and the people on your side until election day?

apps.name: Coven of Thorns
apps.short_description: Five witches. Five familiars. One Root. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: pick a witch and her familiar, build a deck and climb the Thorn Road through a cursed wood, a bridge of briars and a candle-lit chapel to the Gardener. Every run is a new map.

apps.name: Crashloop
apps.short_description: CRASHLOOP is a roguelike deckbuilder about hacking your way through a botnet. Build machines out of hexagonal tiles, chain them into loops, and crash every foe that stands in your way as you find out who's behind it all.

apps.name: Crowd of Knives
apps.short_description: An online PvP stealth game where every assassin looks like an NPC. Blend into a crowded medieval marketplace, hunt your targets, and strike without being seen. Get caught killing, and the bounty is on your head. Now you're the one being hunted. Pick and use your abilities to outplay the others.

apps.name: Curse of Beauty
apps.short_description: Beauty demands sacrifice. Here, it's literal. Clock in at a factory that makes cosmetics out of people. Mix the ingredients, follow instructions, and try not to dwell on what you're doing. By the end of your shift, your hands will still be dirty.

apps.name: Daibouken: Yarinaosu
apps.short_description: "Daibouken: Yarinaosu" is an Action Adventure RPG where players explore vibrant worlds, solve puzzles, clear dungeons, and battle foes within a mysterious time loop. Join Aurora as she navigates a fate intertwined with gods and time itself.

apps.name: DARK FARM : The Last Harvest
apps.short_description:
Fantasy PvPvE RPG in Norse Mythology
Conquer key positions and collect weapons on the battlefield. Use tactics and gear to battle gods, monsters, and other players. Survive, win, and escape the warzone.

apps.name: Dash Dash Dead
apps.short_description: Play as a death row inmate competing for freedom in a show designed to kill for entertainment. Hunt targets, build deadly item combinations, and survive long enough to matter in this turn-based dungeon crawler roguelite. The clock is ticking & the viewers want blood. Are you in?

apps.name: DEAD ZONE: Idle Arsenal RPG
apps.short_description: Your squad of animal soldiers fights hordes of infected on its own, even with the game closed. In this idle shooter RPG, you build the team, equip weapons, raise a bunker for survivors, and risk it all on expeditions for better loot.

apps.name: Deadtone
apps.short_description: Hold the last fortress against hundreds of thousands of zombies in Deadtone, an incremental tower defense game. Set your firing lines, call in air support and grow stronger with permanent upgrades. Take the world back, region by region.

apps.name: Deathly Delights
apps.short_description: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

apps.name: Deep Shaft
apps.short_description: Sink your own mine shaft from bare land to the Earth's core. Dig by hand, then bring in excavators, dozers, haul trucks, hoists, rail and a tunnel boring machine. Every layer - sand, clay, granite, basalt, magma - fights back. Co-op for 1-8 players.

apps.name: DEEPest RESEARCH
apps.short_description: She wants to kill the man who stole her love. To do so, she... His missing wife's phone reveals a hidden side: sweet whispers, sultry breaths, messages from strange men. Sick with anguish, the lawyer seeks the truth. But does he have secrets too? A smartphone mystery filled with forbidden desires!

apps.name: Definitely Express
apps.short_description: Run a chaotic holiday warehouse with up to 8 players! Scan, sort and launch parcels into departing trucks, pull off bicycle-kick deliveries, curve shots off forklifts and fight off rival drones. Work together, cause chaos and get those packages moving. Careful handling is optional.

apps.name: Demon Eye
apps.short_description: Eyes are your weapons in this bullet heaven extraction shooter. Drop into raids, gather materials, fight waves of demons, and extract with your loot. Back in the Hideout, use your loot to craft eyes, make upgrades, trade, and take on quests.

apps.name: Demon King's Domain
apps.short_description: Become the Demon King in a pixel-art roguelite tower defense. Draft tiles, build a monster tribe and turn positioning into power: outer tiles fight, inner tiles support. Combine relics and spells to survive 30 waves of human invaders.

apps.name: Devil's Sanctum
apps.short_description: Survive the Devil’s trials and earn your freedom in this top-down arena shooter. Cast into Hell as the Challenger, wade through relentless waves of demons and shape your build with powerful attunements.

apps.name: Die Fighter
apps.short_description: A sci-fi dice-driven roguelike where your dice fuel both your abilities and your enemies’.  You'll need strategy and luck to outwit dynamic foes, harness synergistic upgrades, and escape creeping galactic doom before Fate catches up.

apps.name: Divination Quest
apps.short_description: The latest wasitworthit immersive sim project and the final entry of the Quest Anthology in full 3D. Grab a buddy and experience everything you love about imm sim's together for one last quest. Designed from the ground up for co-op. It's not just a campaign with networking; it's the co-op campaign.

apps.name: DomiNoooos
apps.short_description: Set up tens of thousands of dominoes, turn photos into giant picture walls, build stairs, bridges and levers – then tip the first stone and watch it all come down. Real physics that falls exactly the same on every PC, solo or with friends.

apps.name: Don't Sell the Cat
apps.short_description: Seven nights behind the counter of a pawnshop that opened in 1958. Check what people bring in with a loupe, a UV lamp, a scale and the shop cat. Pay the rent. The ledger writes lines you didn't write, and someone knocks on the back shutter after closing. Don't open it.

apps.name: Doom Keeper
apps.short_description: A fast-paced arena action roguelike about mercenaries fighting on the edge of the galaxy. Choose your hero, battle hordes of aliens, create powerful builds, and turn your body into the ultimate weapon with combat implants.

apps.name: DOPAMIN CUBE
apps.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite shooter where every level-up is a slot machine spin. Dodge bullet storms, stack wild upgrades, fuse synergies into your own abilities and merge your guns to see how far your build can go.

apps.name: Dragon Joust
apps.short_description: Two riders. Four dragons. One sky to rule. Pick the Orc King or the Sorceress Queen, saddle up a fire, ice, poison, or magic dragon, and joust your rivals out of the clouds. Raid villages, summon storms, call a Titan, or just fly for high scores, solo, online or tournament with 8 players .

apps.name: DRAMAtical Murder re:code NITRO ARCHIVE
apps.short_description: NITRO CHiRAL's hit BL adventure game DRAMAtical Murder re:code is now available on Steam! Aoba, our protagonist, spends his days working part-time at Hum-Drum Junk. All he ever wanted was to live a peaceful life. However, strange events have begun transpiring in places beyond his fathoming.

apps.name: Dread Omen
apps.short_description: 1980. Arkham, Massachusetts. A once-peaceful town has been engulfed by an inexplicable catastrophe. Monstrous creatures roam its streets, and the familiar world is gradually giving way to something alien and incomprehensible. As Detective Arthur Sullivan, you must find your son Henry.

apps.name: DSP Bench
apps.short_description: Wire blocks into a live signal chain, then hear what you built. Solve 66 digital signal processing puzzles, from sampling and filters to echoes, FM synthesis and a vocoder. Learn with lessons and optional hints, then build freely in the sandbox.

apps.name: Duck Billiards
apps.short_description: Duck Billiards is a bullet heaven where your attacks are determined by billiard balls and runs are lightning quick. Play as cool duck wizards and unlock lots of items and levels!

apps.name: Dungeon of the Forgotten King
apps.short_description: In DUNGEON OF THE FORGOTTEN KING you will fight against dangerous enemies to obtain Gold, which you can offer to the Magic Altars to become more powerful, hoping to find the way out of the dungeon.

apps.name: Dungeon Treaders
apps.short_description:
A classic-style 3D dungeon crawler that blends nostalgic challenge with modern comfort.
Enjoy flexible character creation and a classic world, now with streamlined, trial-and-error gameplay.

apps.name: Dwarf the Dungeonist
apps.short_description: Carry your inventory above your head. Solve puzzles with it. Play as a dwarf in a turn-based puzzle crawler with roguelite elements. Place objects, activate mechanisms, and outwit monsters as you explore dungeons.

apps.name: Eldrath: O Núcleo Primordial
apps.short_description: An action roguelite with bow and arrow where difficulty increases as you progress. Face waves of enemies, build powerful builds with cards and evolve in real time. Each run brings new challenges and combinations. How far can you go?

apps.name: Eras of Myths and Monsters
apps.short_description: Eras of Myths and Monsters is a hero-led turn-based fantasy strategy game inspired by the classics. Explore the world, develop your castles, recruit armies, and lead your heroes into tactical battles. Challenge computer opponents or take turns with friends in local hotseat multiplayer.

apps.name: Espetero Simulator
apps.short_description: Become the king of the grill in the world's first Espetero Simulator! Master the art of skewering sardines, control the fire on the sand, and manage the rush hour of a busy chiringuito in the heart of the Costa del Sol. Can you handle the August heat, or will your business go up in smoke?

apps.name: Evac
apps.short_description: Co-op marines vs. the alien hive. Fight through infested outposts where the layout shifts every round, call the dropship and get out. Every marine who dies rises as one of them. 1–16 players, with AI filling any empty slot.

apps.name: Evermine
apps.short_description: Mine ore, haul it home and feed it into your ever-growing factory. Level up to unlock explosive mining skills, spend your profits on more machines and better gear, then prestige for machines & upgrades money can't buy. Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players.

apps.name: Evil Maiden: The Noble Warrior and the Demon Armor
apps.short_description: In a war‑torn otherworld, the warrior Alice survives only by relying on her companions in the mercenary band. But when she returns from a mission, she finds every member slaughtered and her younger sister taken by a mysterious woman in white.

apps.name: Extraction Manifest
apps.short_description: Extraction Manifest is a fast-paced loot-and-extract game. Drop into a hostile zone, grab mission loot and high-value gear, then get out alive. Will you carry a wounded teammate? Call in an airdrop mid-search? Build a top-tier gun for your rover dog? Every call is yours.

apps.name: Fewer Mornings
apps.short_description: Fewer Mornings is a short first-person game about everything you do before you leave the house. Unpack, cook, do the dishes, feed Saki, answer your mom, leave by eight. Five days in one apartment across twelve years, and there's never time for all of it.

apps.name: FishOmatic
apps.short_description: Fish the island waters yourself, discover rare catches, and send robots out to bring in the rest. Build a humming fish factory, help the village grow into a lively community, then sit back, relax, and watch your seafood empire run itself. Automation has never been this cozy.

apps.name: FOCOM: Forward Operations Commander
apps.short_description:
Command your forces from a forward operating base in a land held by an insurgency. Order every soldier yourself, push
patrol bases out, win over the towns and hunt down the camps the insurgents fight from. A real-time commander game on one
living map that remembers what you do.

apps.name: FORGE
apps.short_description: Build your factory in the valley. Extract resources, connect production chains and balance materials, water and power. Expand your factories across six chapters, fulfil delivery contracts and master timed production trials – with your own local music.

apps.name: Forts of Canada
apps.short_description: Forts of Canada is a single-player 2D strategy game about keeping eight historic Canadian forts standing. Manage supplies, recruit troops, fire the cannons, sail dangerous waters and plan battles before watching them unfold.

apps.name: Friendgeist
apps.short_description: An online co-op horror comedy for up to 5 players. You wake up trapped in a house haunted by the Friendgeist, a spirit that takes the shape of a friend to deceive and possess you. Find the way out. If one of you gets possessed, exorcise them before it's too late. Or escape, if they let you.

apps.name: Garden Souls
apps.short_description: Garden Souls is a 2D action roguelite focused on fast combat, stylish combos and build crafting. Choose one of the four Garden Princesses, unlock new strikes, combine elements and adapt your combat style each run to face corrupted floral biomes and stop the Mandragora.

apps.name: Gas N Cars
apps.short_description: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

apps.name: Glowmonkey2k
apps.short_description: Fight through a corrupted digital world as Glowmonkey, switching weapons on the fly to defeat enemies immune to the wrong attack.

apps.name: GOALTURN
apps.short_description: Goalturn is a turn-based football card game. Pass, dribble and shoot across a painted 11v11 pitch, play tactic cards, pick one of six playing styles and collect over 250 players. Every risky move shows its chance before you commit.

apps.name: GOLFNERD
apps.short_description: Build your own little world of golf. GOLFNERD is a golf course model-building sandbox with a charming management simulation tucked inside. Shape beautiful landscapes, design your dream courses, watch tiny golf nerds play, and enjoy the art of making a place entirely your own.

apps.name: Gooney
apps.short_description: Gooney is a cute, cutthroat 1v1 honey puzzle duel. Build a puzzle, scramble it, hand it to your rival. Race to solve theirs first, with hat powers to sabotage them. Play online, against bots, or through 100 solo levels.

apps.name: Grand Avenue Hotel
apps.short_description: Run a city hotel with your own hands. Check guests in at a real front desk, count the change, clean and restock rooms, haul supplies from across the street, then hire staff, open a restaurant, a spa and new floors, and turn a tired one-star building into a five-star hotel.

apps.name: Grandma Left Me A Building
apps.short_description: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

apps.name: GRASS.EXE
apps.short_description: 🌿 Mow grass in a nostalgic digital world! Earn money, upgrade your tools, destroy viruses, explore mysterious folders 📁, and uncover hidden secrets. What starts as a relaxing grass-cutting simulator slowly turns into something much stranger. 👁️

apps.name: Griffinblade
apps.short_description: A 2.5D action-adventure with deep exploration. Master powerful relics and explore a handcrafted world as Daryn—sent to recover a sacred artifact, but awakening to a power he never knew he carried.

apps.name: Grim Gambit
apps.short_description: A card-puzzle roguelite where every card you place on a dungeon grid is a higher-or-lower bet. Guess wrong and part of your board explodes. Poker hands heal you, counting cards is encouraged, and the Grim Reaper runs the table. One standard 52-card deck. Fill the grid. Cheat death.

apps.name: Guildlands
apps.short_description: Forge, fight and trade, together. A multiplayer idle RPG that lives on your taskbar: your hero fights, mines and fishes while you work, and every piece of gear you forge shows on them. Free to play, in a shared world where players set every price.

apps.name: Guttering Light
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder in a vault that is running out of light. Descend four depths as one of four heroes, building a deck from cards, stones and draughts as you go. Your torch is a resource — let it gutter and experience greater pain. The lords of the vault stand between you and victory.

apps.name: Half Punch
apps.short_description: Half Punch - is a Boxing game with Totally Accurate physics. Intuitive slipping and dodging, satisfying punches, High IQ fighting and tactics.

apps.name: Ham(mer) It Up
apps.short_description: Ham(mer) It Up is a zany, couch coop blacksmithing management game where you make customers' orders in a timely manner, ensuring they don't leave upset and without paying.

apps.name: Handwalk
apps.short_description: Handwalk is a difficult physics-based rage game where you control each hand separately to climb a mountain on your hands.

apps.name: Hanoi Puzzles: Spin Match
apps.short_description:
Inspired by the classic Tower of Hanoi,
Assemble towers by spinning pieces to get the right pattern on a hexagonal board with a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere.

apps.name: Harper's Hallways
apps.short_description: Haunted by the bullies of his past, Harper is looking to take his vengeance out on you. Find and eat four apples to evade capture, and escape the hallways.

apps.name: HEAL PLEASE!
apps.short_description: Play as the only healer of your guild, and make sure your mates don't run to their doom... Heal your way through dungeons, grow your party, loot dungeons in this solo party-based semi auto-battler RPG.

apps.name: Healing Time
apps.short_description: Healing Time is a game about sitting with friends on a photoreal seaside. Under a parasol by day and beside a campfire by night, listen to the waves and the fire while you talk or simply rest.

apps.name: Heirs to the Realm
apps.short_description: A classic real-time strategy game of mice, badgers, hares and rats. Gather and build on the ruins of a lost realm, advance from the Stone Age to the Iron Age, and raise an army to take the land your ancestors once shared.

apps.name: Hentai Tales: Chesty Gyaru Naughty Service
apps.short_description:
You're an ordinary office worker, crushed by overtime and a boss who never stops. 
Late one night, in the family restaurant where you always hide from the world, 
a chesty gyaru part-timer drags you into the stockroom and locks the door.

apps.name: Hero Of The Guitar
apps.short_description: In this *Seraph's Last Stand*-inspired roguelike, you play as a guitarist without a band who must eliminate other musical instruments—with the piano serving as the boss—while collecting upgrades and abilities to face increasingly powerful enemies.

apps.name: Hidden Gnomes
apps.short_description: A simple hidden object game with hand-drawn art. Find specific gnomes in the large crowd. Gnome appearances and locations are randomized in every session, making the game replayable.

apps.name: Hollow Sky
apps.short_description: A third-person survival horror game set during an alien invasion. Scavenge supplies, hide from lethal creatures, lure them into traps, exploit strange anomalies, and fight hostile survivors

apps.name: Holoverse Armada
apps.short_description: Holoverse Armada is a fast-paced sci-fi spaceship shooter where you pilot a powerful spacecraft, battle enemy spaceships, and dodge incoming laser fire. Fight across alien planetary environments, master evasive maneuvers, and survive intense aerial combat.

apps.name: Hot Rewind
apps.short_description: Run your own video rental store in Hot Rewind! Buy and collect ever-HOTTER DVDs, fill your shelves, and discover your customers’ tastes. Manage rentals, returns, and rewinds, upgrade your store, and become the king of DVDs!

apps.name: How To Get A Goth GF: 101
apps.short_description: You’re down bad, your rizz is questionable, but goth girls are about to become your entire personality. Make choices, survive the red flags, and see whether you can pull a goth mommy, or just get left on read - in this chaotic dating-sim visual novel.

apps.name: I Herd Ewe
apps.short_description: It's time for the sheep to head home! Will you command your team of dogs to round them up in as few turns as possible? Or will the sheep outsmart you with their wooly ways? Make use of each dog's unique ability to get the sheep home as efficiently as possible in this wholesome tactical puzzle game.

apps.name: Idleplace
apps.short_description: Place hovering land on your sky island. Close a region to construct your buildings, then muster an army to fight the invaders landing. Collect gear from bosses as well as gaining gear in village. In battle turn on auto and your island fights on while you're idle, even floating on your desktop.

apps.name: In-yu Quest ~Quest for the Queen~
apps.short_description: Twenty years after the demons first appeared, the Hero has already fallen! With Queen Niferina’s cursed sigil twisting your thoughts, can you carry on your quest—or surrender to a life of submission?

apps.name: Incremental Ants
apps.short_description:
Hatch ants. Explore parks. Steal picnic baskets.

Incremental Ants is a game about growing an ant colony. Gather food using a variety of ants, upgrade their skills, unlock new species, and expand into territory where no ant has gone before.

apps.name: Inkvasion
apps.short_description: Inkvasion is a 4v4 tank battler where paint wins territory. Upgrade speed, firepower and more, evolve into one of 24 final tanks, and capture Drop Zones for drone reinforcements. Squad up online or experiment against bots in offline Practice.

apps.name: Inside the Samosbor
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1–4 players set in the world of Samosbor. Explore contaminated residential blocks, find a way out, and evade monsters and anomalies. Beware of liquidators who may mistake you for the infected. Get out alive.

apps.name: Iridium Bones
apps.short_description: Dive into a thrilling space roguelike where survival demands tactical brilliance. Upgrade your starship, loot devastating weapons, and master intense strategic combat across the galaxy. Every run is a new battle; every choice shapes your legacy.

apps.name: Iron & Arrow
apps.short_description: Survive the undead in a dark fantasy action roguelite. Swap between melee and ranged weapons, dash through the horde, and pick upgrades as you fight across eight acts of survival, escort, siege, and last stand missions.

apps.name: Ironfall
apps.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite in a fallen kingdom of rune-forged relics. Pick one of 20 heroes, cut through endless swarms, fuse weapons and items into powerful evolutions, and raise the Run Curse until the Reaper himself comes for you.

apps.name: Jibtik - جبتك
apps.short_description:
Play Solitaire. Move cards, undo a move, start a new deal, or check the in-game guide at your own pace. Then Explore DLCs.
العب سوليتير بنظام سحب بطاقة واحدة. يمكنك نقل البطاقات،  والتراجع عن خطوة، وبدء جولة جديدة، أو الرجوع إلى دليل اللعبة وبالسرعة التي تناسبك. ثم إستكشف الألعاب الأخرى.

apps.name: Jumi's Reverie
apps.short_description: Build your deck, collect incredible cards, and battle gods beyond comprehension.

apps.name: Junction Zero
apps.short_description: Junction Zero is a cyberpunk action roguelite where automatic weapon cycles meet manual twin-stick aiming as you choose a character, shape a tactical build with weapons and cyberware, and fight through escalating enemy hordes in the locked-down city of Palisade.

apps.name: Kaya Shock Golf
apps.short_description: Celebrate shocktober like never before!  Take a shot with your electric power beam to try hitting Kaya in the fewest shots possible!  Ride your golf cart to the next tee location as you work your way towards your goal of sending kaya flying, but be careful!  You wouldn't want to do her in!

apps.name: Keeb Type
apps.short_description: Learn to type on your own keyboard. Keeb Type reads your layout and layers, shows which finger presses each key and builds lessons from your home keys up. Then race friends online and climb the leaderboards.

apps.name: Keep Farming Aura
apps.short_description: Farm Aura and turn every move into momentum. Attract a crowd, build your crew, unlock upgrades and face powerful rivals as you grow from an unknown into an Aura legend in this active 3D incremental game.

apps.name: Keepsies: It's All Mine!
apps.short_description: Win a fight, take something from your opponent's bag. Lose, and they take from yours. An auto-battler roguelike about packing items into a grid backpack, where the dungeon studies your build and comes prepared with counters. Swap in gear from your Sub Bag, outsmart it, and claim it all!

apps.name: KIT Heroes at War
apps.short_description: A free-to-play real-time battle game for mobile and PC, with in-game purchases. Drag commander cards to direct troops, or connect a mobile device as your PC control board. Mix commanders and troop types freely. All commanders are obtainable for free, without gacha.

apps.name: Kādomon: Incremental Eclipse
apps.short_description: Build a team of Kādomon that fights for you, then push deeper. An Idle Incremental RPG where your creatures auto-battle through endless waves, each with their own skill tree to master. Eclipse your run to unlock permanent power and climb further than ever before.

apps.name: Lab Trials
apps.short_description: You signed up for a lab trial. Now the door behind you is locked. A first-person co-op maze game for 1 to 8 players: split up, mark the walls, ferry keycards between zones and talk your way through a labyrinth that never stays the same, while the Proctor tries to catch you.

apps.name: Le Cœur de l'Hydre
apps.short_description: Dive in a dark world with Le Cœur de l’Hydre, a fantasy visual novel that blends art, science, and the occult. Meet various characters and mysterious creatures and take decisions to survive.

apps.name: Lilithia's Dungeon
apps.short_description: Lilithia’s Dungeon is a pixel-art real-time turn-based looter RPG with anime flair. You are a hero summoned by Lilithia – level up, explore the dungeon, and defeat bosses. Even casual players can use real-time inputs in turn-based combat to keep challenging and overcoming tough enemies.

apps.name: Limb & Liminal
apps.short_description: Build and run your own big box store! Expand and unlock new features for your customers. Work with friends to help manage the chaos!

apps.name: Little Brigade
apps.short_description: A relaxing (because apparently you're not involved) idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you go about your day.

apps.name: Longbows & Potatoes
apps.short_description: A very serious real-time strategy game about potatoes. Mash your friends in ranked 1v1 to 4v4, 16-player parties or Battle Royale.

apps.name: Lurking Exploit
apps.short_description: A sandbox space MMO in one shared galaxy of 200+ star systems. Mine, refine and build in a player-run economy, run missions and salvage derelicts, then band together in corporations and alliances for open PvP across high, low and no security space. Anything you undock with can be lost.

apps.name: Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction
apps.short_description: Run a mad science supply shop with up to 3 friends: brew potions, stock shelves and serve strange customers by day. By night, pilot a giant robot together, smash cities, fight superheroes and climb the ranks of the Society of World Destruction!

apps.name: Mafia Deal
apps.short_description: Mafia Deal is an online auction game for 3–6 players. Gather your crew of mobsters and bid on collectibles with hidden twists. Hype up your wares, place secret bids, and outsmart your friends to make a fortune. Bid the same amount? Draw your guns and let your aim settle the deal!

apps.name: Mall Manager
apps.short_description: Welcome to Mall Manager, where you can build and manage your personalized mall. Choose your manager, design from scratch, and expand across unique worlds. A friendly indie management sim.

apps.name: Mars Divided
apps.short_description: A turn-based grand strategy game about factions fighting over Mars. Research technologies, trade with Earth, wage war and forge alliances, push laws through your parliament, ride out dust storms. And beneath it all live tens of thousands of colonists — and the game simulates every one.

apps.name: Mars Tactics
apps.short_description: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.

apps.name: Mask Splitters
apps.short_description: Play as a powerful ninja archer capable of teleporting to your arrows. Outplay and outsmart your friends in this frantic arena party game and become the ultimate Mask Splitter!

apps.name: Masterwork
apps.short_description: Masterwork delivers an innovative crafting experience with rich underlying physics!  Experience more than 7 trades and professions!  Content created in Masterwork can be exported for use in other contexts and 3D environments!

apps.name: math is hard
apps.short_description: math is hard is a sokoban-style puzzle game where the numbers are blocks you push around until the math works out. Line them up into equations, hit the target value, and master special blocks that change the rules.

apps.name: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure
apps.short_description: Embark on a brand-new RuneScape idle adventure with Melvor Idle 2. Master iconic RuneScape Skills, face powerful Combat challenges, or uncover the history of the world via Quests, all while enjoying zen-like progression.

apps.name: Metropol
apps.short_description: Metropol is a relaxing city-building sandbox featuring 2D isometric visuals. Design your dream city, build infrastructure, shape the landscape, and create your own urban worlds, all at your own pace.

apps.name: Mickey Palooka
apps.short_description: Win the fight. Or take the dive. A boxing solitaire game where your punches and his come from the same deck. Pick your fights, bet on the outcome, and play your way out of a $3,500 debt. You have ten weeks. The bookmaker is counting.

apps.name: Mighty Mini Golf
apps.short_description: Mighty Mini Golf is a wild mini golf adventure! Golf through crazy hazards using wild items in both single and local multiplayer modes. Fight and block hazards with swings of your club, fight dangerous bosses in single player mode, and explore map screens and unlock new characters and courses!

apps.name: Minotaur Hotel
apps.short_description: A mythology-inspired gay visual novel about the legendary Minotaur. Manage a magical hotel, explore the stories of mythical beings from around the world, and uncover the realm's dark history.

apps.name: Miraclawns
apps.short_description: A unique roguelite strategy where you strengthen slimes through gambling. As the Demon King, use fate-altering bets to boost your small slimes' stats and deploy them to the frontlines. Will your judgment or overwhelming "luck" overcome the brutal battlefield?

apps.name: Monolith Zero - An Incremental Odyssey
apps.short_description: A pixel art incremental game of mining and drones. "Captain, the mothership has lost control near an unknown structure. We're stuck. It's pulling iron-laden asteroids towards us… It seems to want to help us."

apps.name: Mosquito Problem
apps.short_description: Survive as a mosquito in a punk musician’s apartment. Learn his habits, avoid his traps and slaps, drink his blood and upgrade your skills. Spend blood at the Roach Market, spin the Lucky Wheel for free boosts and explore an apartment full of fun, interactive things to do.

apps.name: Mossgrave
apps.short_description: You wake in a gravekeeper's cottage with no memory and no skills, and the Obelisk on the hill opens only for a master of all twenty-two. Chop, smith, fight and sing the dead to rest in a foggy single-player Vale, then lie down and rise again, quicker every life.

apps.name: Muchi
apps.short_description: Meet Muchi, a free-to-play desktop pet who makes your screen feel cozier. Show him affection, offer food and water, tend a little garden, or take a break with minigames while he wanders, plays, and rests alongside your day. No rush, no pressure.

apps.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!
apps.short_description: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.

apps.name: Musicality
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op music toy. Plug synths, drums and pedals together in your own little home, record takes for the neighbours, and jam with friends over Steam.

apps.name: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
apps.short_description: The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv Alternative" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

apps.name: Nearsight
apps.short_description: You are a clumsy, nearsighted photographer who got demoted after making far too many mistakes, now trying to prove yourself through wildlife photography.

apps.name: Neon Run
apps.short_description: Neon Run is a fast-paced precision platformer inspired by old-school arcade games. Jump, slide and dash through challenging levels, master their patterns, discover hidden secrets, defeat enemies and bosses, and unlock new content as you progress.

apps.name: NERIS ZERO
apps.short_description: A fast, hard-hitting quarter-view katana roguelite. Cut in three-hit combos, dash in and out, raise your shield. Rewrite how your blade strikes, swing found weapons or turn them into buffs, and chain burn, venom and shock into new swordplay every run. Fall, grow stronger in town, go again.

apps.name: NEW COLD WAR
apps.short_description: Lead the United States or China in a turn-based strategy board game. Play cards, expand your influence, and compete across six regions while managing the technology race and a global crisis that could end the game.

apps.name: No, I'm not addicted to packs
apps.short_description: Rip open packs in this incremental trading card game! Collect hundreds of unique cards across themed sets, upgrade your packs, sacrifice cards for rewards and complete challenges to earn stars for permanent upgrades. Chase the rarest pulls and build your ultimate collection!

apps.name: NODE ZERO
apps.short_description: Investigate system failures, trace corrupted infrastructure, and keep the node alive before stability reaches zero. NODE ZERO is an interface-driven psychological horror game where something inside the system is learning how you work.

apps.name: Nonolith
apps.short_description: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

apps.name: Nordic Order
apps.short_description: A party-based auto-battle RPG: program your allies with [condition] → [action] orders. When to Guard, when to Heal, it's all up to your tactics. Lead a knight, thief, priest and mage against the hordes. Even in defeat, the bestiary and battle log show what to fix. Rewrite your orders and try again!

apps.name: Novaris
apps.short_description: Divert all power to fun! Mothership brings tabletop fleet management, strategy, and thrilling combat into a seamless digital experience. Control a fleet of ships and charge through the galaxy, capturing planets, building defenses, and amassing powerful technologies.

apps.name: Odyssey of Elemental Elysium
apps.short_description: Five elemental realms. Decades of lore. One of the largest RPGs ever made. Experience the Odyssey of Elemental Elysium.

apps.name: Off Grid Pop
apps.short_description: Pop the right bubbles. Let the impostors pass. Help Otis, a bayou grandpa with a hungry toad, survive 30 absurd captcha tests on his old TV. A clay miniature look, rising pressure, and one very unreasonable Department stand between him and proof he's human.

apps.name: Off the Table!
apps.short_description: An incremental game about a cat and a table crowded with stuff. Before your human gets back, knock mugs, toys, phones and grand pianos onto the floor: things that clearly don't belong on a table. Spend points on upgrading your cat.

apps.name: Ooga
apps.short_description: Help Ooga to retrieve his stolen food stockpile in this fast-paced, spear-based parkour platformer. Play the first world and a half in the free demo, secrets included!

apps.name: ORYFT
apps.short_description: Drill through underground walls, collect resources, craft powerful drills, and fight the creatures lurking beneath the surface. Restore the Lumera-01, defeat five bosses, and test your skills in the Infinite Rift.

apps.name: OUTLIER
apps.short_description: OUTLIER is an online hide-and-seek game for up to 16 players, set in an uncharted zone of the Backrooms where strange symptoms have begun to appear. Blend into a crowd of identical hazmat suits and secretly let out the unbearable urge. The Overseer is watching. Can you act normal to the end?

apps.name: Overcharge
apps.short_description: Overcharge is a robot-themed 2-4 player co-op action platformer. Pass the Energy Core between teammates as you run, jump, and dodge through deadly obstacle courses. Hold onto the core for too long and your team gets wiped. Climb the Ascension spires, overcome the Gauntlet, or build your own maps.

apps.name: Pack it! Part-Time Master
apps.short_description:
Scan! Stack! The ultimate basket-packing challenge!
Become a part-time master!

apps.name: Pact, Passion, Puchimon!
apps.short_description: Journey across a continent teeming with diverse monsters! Capture them through intense bullet-hell battles and grow stronger together. With an in-depth nurturing system, you can build bonds with your "Puchimon" to unlock exclusive storylines and turn them into your ultimate battle partners!

apps.name: Paschalis TD
apps.short_description: Build and upgrade towers to defend yourself against various enemies.

apps.name: Past The Last Sky
apps.short_description: Build a space program that reaches the stars in this 1:1 scale spaceflight and colony sim. Design rockets and fly them with real orbital mechanics. Land anywhere in a procedural universe of over two million real star systems, then set up space stations, colonies and factories. How far can you go?

apps.name: Patience Balls
apps.short_description: Tilt interconnected boards to guide the balls into their holes. Master 100 hand-crafted levels across walled Zen Mode and wall-less Patience Mode, create custom puzzles with the Level Editor, and climb global leaderboards.

apps.name: Pawlifters!
apps.short_description: A 2–6 player party heist game, local or online. Cute animal thieves hide in plain sight: grab the loot and blend into the crowd. Or become the guard and whack your friends with a baton — just don’t mix them up with the visitors!

apps.name: PawTop Cats
apps.short_description: PawTop Cats is a cozy app with animated cats that live on top of your windows. Choose different skins, interact with your fluffy assistants, and add a little cute chaos to your desktop.

apps.name: Pentatile
apps.short_description: Start with a star. Grow something unexpected. Pentatile is a geometric sandbox where you build a colorful mosaic, discover new shapes in the spaces between, and share your creations with other explorers.

apps.name: Penumbra: Requiem
apps.short_description: Puzzle expansion for Penumbra: Black Plague. Requiem is part of Penumbra: Black Plague Gold Edition, included in the Penumbra Collection.

apps.name: Picky Numbers
apps.short_description: Picky Numbers is a game based on lottery mechanics. Buy tickets, choose numbers, and watch as the drum draws results one by one. The more numbers you hit, the bigger the payout. Each ticket is a different strategy, with higher risk and higher reward, or a JACKPOT.

apps.name: Pikku Adventure
apps.short_description: Befriend the Pikku to decipher a mysterious alien language and deliver a crucial message. Small colorful planets filled with secrets and charm await clever deduction from sharp puzzle-venturers and exo-linguists.

apps.name: Pipe or Die
apps.short_description: The co-op horror game where you build a factory. Lay pipe with up to 5 friends at the bottom of a monster-infested mine, fill crates, and make rent... or die.

apps.name: Pixel Armada
apps.short_description: Design your own ships, assemble a fleet, and fight tactical 2D space battles across space battles, with dynamic damage fast paced combat.

apps.name: Plastic Battle Rush
apps.short_description: Battle as plastic army men in this high stakes team FPS. Steal plastic from rivals and haul it to your tubes to bank the win. But beware: the more you carry, the slower you move. One shot, one kill. High speed rounds. Toy themed chaos.

apps.name: Plunderfall
apps.short_description: A co-op action-adventure where you sail a flying ship through floating islands and plunder loot for gold to meet the Captain's demands.

apps.name: Pocket Ocean
apps.short_description: Sway your mermaid fin and dive towards the lake bed to collect pretty pebbles! Customize your merperson, upgrade your skills, trade with trinket-obsessed crows and explore the waters. Dock the game in the corner of your screen so it can keep you company  as you do other things!

apps.name: Pocket Pilots
apps.short_description: Pick a job at a real airport, watch your plane fly it in real time, and get paid when it lands. A relaxed flight career over the real world, with live weather, thousands of airports and pilots from everywhere sharing one sky.

apps.name: Poker Warlords
apps.short_description: Poker but your cards fight to win the pot. Turn cards into armies, complete combos for more power, and claim victory on the battlefield and at the betting table! From the creators of a top-10 StarCraft II custom game, this is poker like you've never played before.

apps.name: POP! A Million Bubbles
apps.short_description: Pop one bubble. Then a thousand. Then ONE MILLION. A cozy, colorful clicker where chain reactions, golden bubbles, bombs and whirlpools turn a gentle pop into a fizzy storm. Grow a 41-node upgrade tree, Rinse for Gum and reach the big finale in about two hours.

apps.name: Potion & Fortune
apps.short_description:
Build your shop, gather ingredients, brew potions. Listen carefully to your customers, distinguish the good from the wicked.
Fight monsters in the darkness of night, take risky decisions, and become your people’s fearless mage.

apps.name: Primal Breakout
apps.short_description: You are the first dinosaur to break out of the lab. Fight through fifteen worlds, raise fifteen prehistoric beasts and build a skill tree of 27 abilities – an incremental where a strike at the right moment deals almost double.

apps.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
apps.short_description: A new adventure in Professor Layton, the puzzle-filled fantasy adventure series that has sold over 20 million copies worldwide. Professor Layton and Luke find themselves drawn into a mysterious case in Steam Bison, a remarkable town of invention powered by steam engine technology.

apps.name: Quantum Chess960
apps.short_description: Play chess across hundreds of possible boards at once. In Quantum Chess960, each move eliminates possibilities and reveals your pieces. Shape the surviving positions, outthink your opponent, and compete online or challenge the computer offline.

apps.name: RAPIDS
apps.short_description: Dare to Deliver in RAPIDS, a frantic co-op roguelike. Either solo or as a group of friends, navigate a hazardous river while delivering packages. Master magic, charm cute critters, and upgrade your boat, one fast-paced run at a time

apps.name: Re-Ball
apps.short_description: A first-person hyper-ball fighter. Hit the ball and it's yours: it flies in your colour and knocks out anyone it touches. Every hit makes it faster. One hit and you're out. Time a PERFECT swing, steal a parry, and send your friends back to the lobby.

apps.name: Regnare
apps.short_description: Lead a kingdom from the saddle in a 3D survival strategy game. Recruit your people, build where the land allows and hold back the night. Explore mysterious islands, uncover ancient powers and learn through discovery, without quest markers or step-by-step guidance.

apps.name: Relicta In Memoriam
apps.short_description: Relicta In Memoriam is a 2.5D pixel-art noir detective game. Explore the secrets of a world where supernatural phenomena threaten human life. Encounter and battle folklore creatures in intense turn-based combat, gather clues, and solve puzzles to unravel dark mysteries.

apps.name: Replacement Heroes
apps.short_description: The usual renowned heroes have been captured, and it's up to the backup squad to save them! Create your protagonist, recruit a team of replacement heroes, and navigate through maze-like caves in this turn-based JRPG dungeon crawler.

apps.name: RGB: EXECUTION
apps.short_description:
RGB: Execution is a fast-paced action game, set in a post-apocalyptic future where Generative AI has taken over a dead world. Each Boss is its own puzzle to solve.
 [RESTART] one last time to uncover the cyclical mystery spanning decades that led to humanity’s second extinction.

apps.name: Robot Gridiron
apps.short_description: American football where every player is a robot — and every robot rolls off the line with a 1 in all eight stats. You are the Owner: call the plays, author the playbook, and turn blank chassis into a championship team. Your first season is free.

apps.name: Rock, Paper, Die!
apps.short_description: A deadly twist on Rock, Paper, Scissors. Build your deck, study your enemies, and turn familiar rules into powerful combinations with weapons, tools and charms. Explore an ever-changing cave filled with monsters, merchants and difficult decisions. Every card matters. Every choice counts.

apps.name: Rookie Spook
apps.short_description: Being dead doesn’t mean behaving yourself. You’re a rookie ghost on your first Halloween, and someone left an entire town full of perfectly possessable belongings. Solve mischievous puzzles, stage absurd pranks, and give the Living something to scream about.

apps.name: RoundRulet
apps.short_description: RoundRulet is fast paced rouge-lite multiplayer shooter were you fight your friends in a procedurally generated map. The loser of every round spins the wheel in the hope to become stronger, but also may become weaker in the proccess.

apps.name: Rpg Forever - Serens Quest
apps.short_description: Awaken in a world without memories as Seren, and embark on a journey through the mysterious land of Expressiaann to uncover your past, shape your destiny, and save a world on the brink of ruin.

apps.name: Salvage Frontier
apps.short_description: Explore an alien frontier in a first- and third-person action RPG Campaign, or lead survivors in Last Rail's turn-based squad battles. Two single-player modes with separate stories and saves: scavenge, mine, craft equipment and bring your people home.

apps.name: SANKAN
apps.short_description: Kill the customer the voice in your head names. Clean up the blood and bury the body before dawn. Or refuse the voice, and it starts hunting you. A story-driven co-op horror for 1-3 players: the night shift at a mountain gas station, Japan, 1999.

apps.name: Satellite Odyssey Online
apps.short_description: Survive in a huge living world seen from above. Every rock and tree has real properties: gather, smelt and craft your way from a stone axe to a musket. Build a home, hunt wild animals, join a clan and claim your place on the official server.

apps.name: Save The Shapes: Chapter 2 - Diamond's Revenge
apps.short_description:
In Save The Shapes: Chapter 2, the Shapes thought their troubles were finally over...
They were wrong.
Diamond is back!

With old friends returning and some new Shapes joining the chaos, you’ll have to survive new dangers, strange places, and whatever Diamond has planned for his revenge.

apps.name: SCP: Vacation
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player online PVP board-based party game. Four D-Class personnel awaken to find themselves in a mysterious dimension. Somehow, they know they must avoid the anomalous threats contained by the SCP Foundation and escape before it's too late...

apps.name: Seagrid Nightfall
apps.short_description: Command three pirates fighting to see dawn in a turn-based tactical roguelite. Read enemy attacks, shove foes into each other or overboard, and turn the Storm King's power against his own minions. Keep your battered ship sailing across a dead ocean.

apps.name: Seavale Fair
apps.short_description: Bring an old seaside fair back to life in this cozy and cute theme park management game. Build stalls and rides, set prices, hire staff and jump into minigames when lines get long. Then watch your visitors ride the pirate ship, swim off the beach, line up for the toilets and plenty more.

apps.name: Seedborne Chronicle
apps.short_description: One seed grows a whole continent: towns with their own stories, deep labyrinths, and companions with dreams of their own. Lead a party through quick turn-based battles, grow old, and hand the adventure to an heir as a new foe rises from the last one.

apps.name: ShatterRush
apps.short_description:
ShatterRush is a multiplayer parkour FPS where fluid movement meets massive mechs in fully destructible levels. Wallrun, grapple, and smash through cover to outplay your foes in kinetic, high-speed combat as the map changes with every fight. 

Join the rush in our free Open Pre-Alpha & wishlist now!

apps.name: She Doesn't Speak My Language
apps.short_description: A dating sim that doubles as English conversation practice. No dialogue choices: say it in your own English, by voice or keyboard, to four women who speak only English. Her face softens when she understands; when she doesn't, she smiles, puzzled, and waits. The AI runs on your PC. No subscription.

apps.name: Ship Life
apps.short_description: An online survival sandbox where everything floats on real physics. Design your own ship, sail by true wind and steam, build, craft and explore a world of kingdoms. Free to play, never pay to win.

apps.name: Shitty City
apps.short_description: An open-world 2.5D retro-arcade crime & racing sandbox! Drift tuned Turbo Bricks across island bridges, pull off chaotic co-op heists, outrun police helicopters, build your own Golden Palace, or time-travel to prehistoric volcano islands!

apps.name: Sil and the Fading World
apps.short_description: Solo Challenging Raid Bosses, Your Way! Craft your perfect build to master intense multi-phase raidboss encounters in this exciting ARPG. Deep customization with 9 specializations, 100s of items, skills and more. No Group, No Queue, All Boss Raids!

apps.name: Skeletons and Stuff
apps.short_description: Four heroes and thousands of skeletons. Take a wizard, a huntress, a barbarian or a pirate through seven battles against a horde that keeps growing, pick a new card every time you level up, sign dark pacts you might regret, and take on the Bone King.

apps.name: Snaps
apps.short_description: An FPS with a twist of strategy—fight cultists in dangerous dungeons, defend your village with tower defense tactics, and build bonds with townsfolk. Upgrade weapons, gamble in the casino, and shape your story in a thrilling blend of action and strategy.

apps.name: Solmorrow: Our Next Sun
apps.short_description: Earth survived the alien swarm, but it can no longer sustain life. Command humanity's last mothership: explore star clusters, mine resources, build outposts and grow your fleets to find a world where we can live again. A story-driven space colony strategy game in seven acts.

apps.name: SolPlex: Dominion
apps.short_description: From a single colony to a galactic empire, every expansion strengthens your economy, your military and your influence as you battle for dominance in a persistent MMO galaxy.

apps.name: Some Type of Trip
apps.short_description: A simple typing narrative game exploring the depths of the mind. Sometimes cozy and warm, sometimes intense and challenging, always interesting.

apps.name: Sort and Stack!
apps.short_description: Turn an overflowing card market into your personal empire! Tear through cards, unlock powerful cutters, unleash five tiers of explosive booster packs, build your skill network, manipulate market prices, and grow stronger with every Prestige.

apps.name: Sort the Chonks
apps.short_description: Sort over 4,000 chonky animal figurines and turn a toy store buried in chaos into a perfectly organized collection. Find the right shelf, earn cash for every correct placement, and unlock upgrades to sort faster and faster.

apps.name: Soul Gear
apps.short_description: A retro-evolved 3D Metroidvania that fuses the fast-paced third-person shooter gameplay with strategic RPG spellcasting! Play as Auruma, a soldier from the steampunk town of Iron Junction, and uncover the mystery surrounding her people as they realize their reality is a lie.

apps.name: SoulRoad
apps.short_description: Rhythm racing meets vehicular combat. Drive, drift, jump and smash to the beat across rollercoaster skies, sunset canyons and trinary star rings. Master 19 distinct rides, survive pack battles, and race your friends over LAN multiplayer.

apps.name: Souls Show Down
apps.short_description:
Eat, and then imagine.
Souls ShowDown is a multiplayer FPS horror game.

apps.name: SpaceVivor
apps.short_description: Lost beyond a wormhole, command a modular starship in real-time space survival. Share scarce energy between engines, shields and weapons, rebuild your ship module by module, lead a crew of four races, fight reptilian fleets and insect swarms and survive as long as you can.

apps.name: Spellthief: The Borrowed Galaxy
apps.short_description: A science fiction action roguelike where you steal the powers of defeated enemies. Combine abilities, upgrade your skills, and battle powerful bosses as you explore a mysterious galaxy.

apps.name: Spexl
apps.short_description: Spexl is an incremental game where you destroy planets made of pixels and collect every particle they’re made of to upgrade your ship. Fly, shoot, and get back to base before you run out of fuel. The challenge is to push farther and farther out.

apps.name: Sphere of Influence
apps.short_description: Shape a tiny living planet. Tens of thousands of creatures follow simple rules of attraction and repulsion on a globe you can paint warm or cold, and every tweak to the climate or the species grid ripples through the whole ecosystem. A quiet, endlessly watchable sandbox with no fail state.

apps.name: SPINDLEDRIFT
apps.short_description: A 2D space trading game with a real economy. NPC ships haul cargo between 78 stations and prices move whether you're there or not. Good routes die as other traders catch on, so you keep hunting new ones. No quest markers, no "best trade" arrows. Just you, a map, and the prices.

apps.name: Starfall
apps.short_description:
You play a ship in the void of space that must survive an increasing horde of enemies. As you progress you level up your abilities. 


Can you survive long enough from the horde of attacks?

apps.name: Starwrit
apps.short_description: Take the Writ. Win the sky. Bring them back alive. Fast, fully voiced bounty-hunter space combat: skim the dusk canyons of Zhar-7, tear a Vreen Hive-Carrier apart node by node, then chase the broker who owns it through the haze and tractor his ship in. Alive. Five ships, 27 weapons.

apps.name: Stellar Dust
apps.short_description: A deep-space real-time strategy game in VR. Command a drone fleet from inside the battlefield. Capture mineral and plasma nodes, build factories, and power your Gateway hub. Refine enough Warp Crystal to win, or capture your opponent's Gateway. How will you seize the Frontier?

apps.name: Street Football: Foul Play
apps.short_description: Play football with no rules, solo or with up to 4 friends in local or online co-op. Customize the weather and disasters, unleash brutal tackles and super shots on your rivals, and turn every match into total chaos!

apps.name: Strike King
apps.short_description: Explore the strange world of competitive bowling as you climb the ranks to become the Strike King. Wield 100+ unique balls as you struggle against eccentric bowlers armed with an arsenal of elements, obstacles, and outlandish abilities in this bowling roguelite.

apps.name: STUCK
apps.short_description: Shake, kick, and upgrade a stubborn vending machine in this first-person incremental game. Collect coins, sell unexpected objects, and build increasingly ridiculous machinery to recover the one bag of chips you paid for.

apps.name: Sun is Lava
apps.short_description: Suit up and cool the Sun in a first-person sci-fi co-op. Spray paths across molten lava, salvage asteroids, build water-powered machines, and explore a dangerous solar world alone or with friends.

apps.name: Super Chasm Hunter
apps.short_description: An unforgiving extraction-roguelite adventure. Gear up and descend alone into the Chasm, fighting enemies and searching for loot. Take risks for better rewards, or extract and return home with what you've earned to sell, craft, decorate, and farm.

apps.name: Survive the Loop
apps.short_description: Survive the Loop is an incremental puzzle game with the overcoat of a dungeon crawler. Attempt to survive a time loop. Balance surviving while advancing quickly. Every time you die or run out of time, the run restarts, leaving you with only the knowledge and skills you learned along the way.

apps.name: SURVIVORS SURVIVE
apps.short_description: Survive a shared battlefield in this online PvPvE action RPG. Combine skills, enhance equipment and form alliances of up to four. Risk your progress for treasure, prepare your next life, and challenge the Vermilion Bird to become the one who ends the season.

apps.name: TaskBound Saga
apps.short_description: An idle JRPG that sits above your taskbar. Four heroes fight through 12 realms on their own while you use your computer. Open the chests they earn, equip the gear and upgrade your party.

apps.name: Taso Idle
apps.short_description: Taso Idle is an incremental game where you flip tasos at recess and sell your stack for cash. Rip open snack packs for rare tasos, buy upgrades and leave the collecting to your little brothers. The bullies can take everything but your name. Start with a bottle cap, become the Schoolyard Legend.

apps.name: Tavern of Tells
apps.short_description: A social deduction game where you uncover the lucky number of each hero gathered at the tavern! Read their clues, work out who is lying, and place enchanted coins across 100 levels. Correct matches stay put, so every deduction brings you closer.

apps.name: Teeny Curio
apps.short_description: Build a castle, then take the lid off. Every tower and cottage in Teeny Curio has rooms inside, and with the roof hidden your town becomes a dollhouse.

apps.name: Tells
apps.short_description: A co-op 1950s detective game for 1-4 players. Question suspects across the interrogation table, watch their faces through the one-way glass, and catch the lie they can't hide. Each detective files a sealed report: name the culprit and climb to Chief, or get busted down to Janitor.

apps.name: Terraformer Wars
apps.short_description:
In the future, mega-corporations send Terraformer colossal machines to fight over dominance on faraway planets.
An auto-battler that will test your management skills to the maximum.

apps.name: The Ascendants
apps.short_description: In a dystopian future ravaged by a pandemic that has left 97% of men sterile, humanity’s survival rests in the hands of a rare group of females known as “Breeders,” born with both male and female genitalia. Packed with humor, grit, and sex, this world is where desire, power, and survival collide.

apps.name: The Baima Harvest Festival
apps.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be   first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

apps.name: The Christmas Bakeshop
apps.short_description: Supply festive breads, pastries, and sweet treats while serving cheerful customers and keeping your shop warm and welcoming. Expand your bakery, discover new recipes, and make your cozy little corner the heart of the town this holiday season.

apps.name: The Garden of Forgotten Blooms
apps.short_description: A watercolor gothic idle RPG. Build a party of 42 flower-named companions, enjoy automatic battles and offline rewards, and explore a 15-chapter story. Japanese and Chinese character voices. No microtransactions.

apps.name: The Lantern Spirits
apps.short_description: Wield a magic lantern in this roguelite shooter and guide the lost spirits home. Combine 100 unique lantern upgrades, unlock a massive skill tree, and leave a glimmer of light behind with every death. Made by four brothers and set to a 25-track original soundtrack composed in-house.

apps.name: The Last Tenant
apps.short_description: The Last Tenant is a short first-person horror game. Explore, find keys, read scattered notes to uncover what happened, and try to escape through tense, atmospheric scares. There is no combat: just you, the dark, and about two hours of dread.

apps.name: The Lost Heir
apps.short_description: Your childhood friend is missing, and home isn’t as you remember it. Explore, gather, craft, and restore your family home in a medieval fantasy adventure about friendship, loss, and finding your place in the world.

apps.name: The Omins
apps.short_description: Build settlements, fight enemies, unite different races, and gain divine powers in this strategy game blending colony sim and RTS with a touch of classic god games. As their Umak, guide generations of Omins through a network of portals, from world to world, in search of the peaceful lands of Ominia.

apps.name: The Onion Spell
apps.short_description:
Explore and solve the enigma of a wizards’ village that had to be contained using the Onion Spell. 
This is your first case within the Magical Affairs Bureau, make sure to make a good impression on the higher ups. Follow the clues and learn new magic to complete your report.

apps.name: The Plushie Atelier
apps.short_description: Open your cozy plush toy workshop! Wash, repair, and sew stuffed animals, or design your own cuddly friends. Decorate your shop, discover your customers’ stories, and enjoy peaceful days with Crumb and your animal companions.

apps.name: The Poker Saint
apps.short_description: Prepare for the most thrilling 2-4 players card game ever—you will face the Poker Saint once again! Use special powers to gain an advantage, use items to disrupt your opponents, and win the game to become the true Poker Saint.

apps.name: The Secret of Weepstone
apps.short_description: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

apps.name: The Seven Beacons
apps.short_description: An idle RPG that lives in a thin strip above your Windows taskbar. While you work, your party fights on its own through 22 zones toward the Demon King. On a short break, open the panel: gear, talents, farm, alchemy, forge, and seven beacons to defend.

apps.name: The Seventh Frame
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where photographs reveal what reality hides. Explore a mysterious family home, solve environmental puzzles with your instant camera, and uncover buried memories in a story shaped by your choices.

apps.name: The Sky Breaker
apps.short_description: A third-person hammer action game inspired by the Dangun myth of Gojoseon. Play as Jinhun, who lost his parents in the chaos caused by Cheonwuidan's opposition to the marriage of Ungnyeo and Hwanung, and embark on a journey of revenge.

apps.name: Throneguard: Last Stand
