apps.short_description: Become the last guardian of the kingdom and defend the throne! Fight on the front lines with your sword, build barricades and towers between waves, and upgrade your hero. Throneguard: Last Stand is a 3D medieval action tower defense game.

apps.name: Tidy Up: Bricks n Blocks
apps.short_description: Thousands of toy bricks are tipped across the floor. Sort every piece onto the right shelf by shape, then into the right bin by color, alone or in online co-op for up to 4. Earn tokens, unlock faster ways to tidy, and clear 14 rooms, two-story buildings and a Cozy Mode that grows as you play.

apps.name: Till you find
apps.short_description: Till You Find is an atmospheric puzzle game with alchemy simulation elements. Explore a mysterious house, collect ingredients, and fulfill residents’ requests. Uncover the city’s secrets and shape its fate through your choices. And above all, reveal the truth behind the alchemist’s past experiments.

apps.name: Tindahan
apps.short_description: Run your grandmother’s store in a quiet Filipino town — but when night falls, strange knocks, whispers, and visions begin.

apps.name: Tiny Mouse Mining Co.
apps.short_description: Tiny Mouse Mining Co. is an incremental game where a tiny mouse digs ever deeper, gathers valuable resources, overcomes dangerous creatures with powerful abilities, and unlocks permanent upgrades to venture farther with every run. How deep will you go?

apps.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege - Test Server
Too Many Orcs!
apps.short_description: Hold back enormous Orc hordes with towers you place and aim yourself. Combine firing arcs and tower roles, build lasting power through the Arsenal and Prestige, and cover increasingly demanding battlefields.

apps.name: Touhou Chihaya Battle Festival
apps.short_description: A fan-made Touhou Project 5v5 multiplayer battle game for up to 10 players. Host your own room, split into two armies with your friends, push down three lanes and take the enemy camp. 30+ characters with their own spell cards, eight team tactics, and a rabbit that delivers your items.

apps.name: Toy or Not
apps.short_description: Toy or Not is an online hide-and-seek party game for up to 8 players. Sneak around as a toy, collect batteries, and rescue your teammates—or play as a kid, spot suspicious toys, and send them back to the toy box. Turn an ordinary room into a playground of sneaky tricks and surprises!

apps.name: TrapRush
apps.short_description: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

apps.name: Ultima™ VII: The Complete Edition
apps.short_description: The first chapter in the third book of the award-winning Ultima saga! Includes both Ultima VII: The Black Gate and Ultima VII Part 2: Serpent Isle.

apps.name: Uncover Space
apps.short_description: An incremental idle game where you fling asteroids and comets into the dust that hides planets, moons and suns. Every broken stone pays for more projectiles and upgrades, and your shots keep breaking dust while you are away.

apps.name: Under The Counter
apps.short_description: A roguelike where your weapon is a tree of absurd pills. Take the wrong prescription, descend the dungeon under Globnix, dodge telegraphed horrors, and build a run-ending arsenal from attacks and charms. Every seed is a new dungeon. Death is just a new dose.

apps.name: Unseen - Someone
apps.short_description: Michael, is a 14-year-old teenager living the ordinary life of a game developer. He usually preferred to work at night because he felt the calm and special atmosphere there. At one point, he needed to leave the room at night but it seems that was a mistake...

apps.name: Unseen Beings
apps.short_description: Unseen Beings is a short survival horror game where you avoid or confront invisible entities while exploring, solving puzzles, and overcoming horrors to pay off your debt. Use special goggles, a taser gun, and your wits to survive the night.

apps.name: Untorra
apps.short_description: Can you traverse the sands of time and remain intact?

apps.name: Vendilooper - original
apps.short_description: Incremental factory + automation clicker + vending machines + steampunk = Vendilooper.  Build a snack empire you can get lost watching. Automate refills, stack machines into towers, and feed trains and rockets to Mars. How many snacks can you vend per minute?

apps.name: Vet Out!
apps.short_description: Vet Out! is a chaotic co-op vet clinic rougelite game for 1 to 4 players. Diagnose and treat sick beloved pets through quick thinking, huck them through the air, and prevent owners from running out of patience. Lose one patient and the run is over.

apps.name: Wall World Strategy
apps.short_description: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall.

apps.name: Warring Kingdoms: Chronicles of War
apps.short_description: A RPG where you build and rule a fantasy kingdom, manage resources, command large-scale battles, and use your character's abilities to change the course of war.

apps.name: Waterfalls Dream
apps.short_description: Waterfall Dreams is an expressive diorama-builder with realistic water behavior. Build your own cozy waterfalls and watch water find its path among the nature scenery. Relax without any goal and paint in a 3D world full of procedural helpers. Imagine a new place - or recreate the one you saw before.

apps.name: Waterscape Atlas
apps.short_description: Walk a life-size beach, sea and offshore island and go sea fishing: surf casting from the sand, sabiki on the breakwaters, float fishing on the island rocks, and deep drops and jigging from a boat you drive yourself. Five living waterscape dioramas to watch and fish in are included.

apps.name: Waves Survive
apps.short_description: You find yourself alone in a wild and unknown land. Gather resources, build a shelter, and fight to survive as dangerous waves of enemies threaten to destroy everything you've built. Can you turn this dangerous place into a home and survive each new wave?

apps.name: Weirdcore.EXE
apps.short_description: An atmospheric weirdcore incremental game about remembering. Click to sift through forgotten childhood memories, nostalgic dreams, and waking nightmares. Automate your reminiscing, unlock surreal upgrades, and ascend into a weirdcore angelic entity!

apps.name: Welcome to Fox Cafe
apps.short_description: Come for the pretty foxes! Fox Cafe has foxes and tea... but no customers. Enjoy everyday stories with little fox Miru and the cafe family, combine characters and abilities, and adventure in two combat styles: classic Vampire Survivors-like survival or rounds with a shop.

apps.name: Westins World
apps.short_description: Westins World is a turn-based RPG where sci-fi meets fantasy. After a supernova scatters civilizations across the galaxy, lead Westin and his party through a story-driven adventure: explore, swap heroes on the fly, gear up your party and face the bosses standing in your way.

apps.name: When Games Collide
apps.short_description: When Games Collide is a collection-first online TCG where every card is a unique, persistent copy. Build decks, battle for rewards, manage condition, preserve prized cards, and search local player markets for the exact revisions your collection needs.

apps.name: Whispering White Oak
apps.short_description: Enter a world where vampires, werewolves, witches, and humans have existed since the beginning of time. Choose your faction, uncover ancient secrets, master supernatural powers, and discover the mystery surrounding the ancient White Oak.

apps.name: WHO THE HELL OPENED THE PORTAL?!
apps.short_description:
A funny pixel art roguelite strategy.
You manage a fantasy island kingdom connected by magical portals.
By day — build, gather resources, hire heroes, and dive through portals to expand into new lands.
By night — defend! The same portals unleash hordes of demons straight from Hell.

apps.name: Without Salvation
apps.short_description: An ordinary dispatch journey of a police officer turns into a dark nightmare with a fatal accident. The mysterious cave at the bottom of the cliff drags you into the demon’s games. In the cursed house where you are trapped, your mission is to detect anomalies and survive by reporting reality.

apps.name: WORLD OF DOGS
apps.short_description: A high-velocity movement shooter set in a city paid to bleed and built to fall. God is laughing.

apps.name: Worm Game
apps.short_description: A puzzle game in which you play as a worm. Push boxes to open the way forward, but beware - it's not so easy to back up when you're a worm.

apps.name: Wrecktangles
apps.short_description: A turn-based 2D physics chaos game where rectangle-shaped soldiers jump, shoot, and destroy the battlefield. Collect absurd card upgrades and survive random map events that turn every short match into a ridiculous, unpredictable story.

apps.name: WW3: Cyber Warfare
apps.short_description: Battle for global supremacy in this fast-paced 2D fighter where world leaders clash across iconic locations worldwide. Master unique special moves, challenge friends in local versus, and fight your way through a satirical Story Mode.

apps.name: Xenograd
apps.short_description: Build a spinning space station one doughnut at a time. Zone its rings, set each zone's air and cater to twelve alien species with their own needs, faiths and grudges, while plagues, pirates, bombers and reality-bending artefacts test your security and medbays.

apps.name: Yokai Batting Game in Kawagoe
apps.short_description:
Blast yokai away with just one button!
A fast and satisfying one-button casual action game set in Kawagoe!
Hit the yokai. Save Kawagoe. There’s only one control.
Hit! Hit! Home run! Smash them out of the park!
Save the souls of the cursed yokai!!
Bring peace back to Kawagoe with your bat!

apps.name: YUNO & DAWN
apps.short_description: A psychological narrative adventure about an alien parasite invasion. Leave the bunker and search for safety alongside your fiancée Yuno. Uncover the mystery of what happened to the world. Question what you can truly trust.

apps.name: Zen Village
apps.short_description: Build a cozy mountain sanctuary for hardworking pandas in Zen Village. Master analog production chains, navigate the shifting four-season cycle, and survive the brutal winter frost in this minimalist pixel-art survival strategy game.

apps.name: Медовый погребок
apps.short_description: Визуальная новелла о молодом человеке, прибывшем на остров, населённый фурри, и неделе его опасных приключений. Любовь, расследование и политические интриги. Или, может, ну их всех? И провести несколько деньков с бокальчиком хмельного мёда?

apps.name: ПВЗ Бездна
apps.short_description: You work at a pickup point. You scan packages, serve customers and keep the warehouse running. Unfortunately, some of the packages aren't really packages. WTF? LOL! They're mimics. Investigate suspicious customers and use the Mind Catcher to uncover mimics. But who is behind them? Find out!

apps.name: ころコロ 2
apps.short_description: corocoro 2! A gyro-exclusive casual game where you tilt the ground to guide 5 uniquely shaped balls to the goal. Overcome the obstacles across all 50 stages!

apps.name: カラクリ電池
apps.short_description: Clockwork Battery is a path-design puzzle game where you discover the  combination of  various scaffolds to create a path and lead a self-moving Clockwork Battery to the unlit lamp.

apps.name: ガールズ&パンツァー オールスター・タンク・カーニバル
apps.short_description: 本作は、アニメ『ガールズ＆パンツァー』を原作とした、戦車を操作して試合を行う戦車道アクションゲームです。TVアニメ・劇場版で描かれた「大洗」の町を、主人公の西住みほと一緒に探索し、仲間たちとの会話を重ねながら、オリジナルストーリーを楽しむことができます。

apps.name: バロック商人 ～ バッハの残響
apps.short_description: A city-building simulation where you freely create your own city on the water. Surrounded by Baroque music, watch merchants stroll through the streets and horse-drawn carriages pass by as you admire the cityscape and its architecture. We invite you to experience **A Moment of Tranquility**.

apps.name: ブルーバイト
apps.short_description: Your "fingertips" will save the world! "BLUE BITE" is a fully voiced 3D romance action adventure set in a world inhabited only by women. Six heroines are threatened by the mysterious disease "bluebite", and the only cure is... your "massage"! Explore the 3D world and save the girls!

apps.name: 三国梦想家
apps.short_description: Forge your path through the Three Kingdoms. Choose a historical faction or create an officer, govern cities, organize armies and plan supplies. Command troops in real-time field battles and sieges, using formations and officer skills to shape your campaign.

apps.name: 倘若你想见到明天
apps.short_description: Welcome, Subject 0216. You have 60 minutes to become an "ideal human," or your collar will explode. With a girl named Tomorrow, face an experiment that judges your worth by looks, wealth, and power. What kind of ending awaits you in this absurd human experiment?

apps.name: 地下城打工日常
apps.short_description: Dungeon diving? Just another errand for the nobles. Pick from 10 jobs, stack hundreds of relics, and build a kit strong enough to clock out in one piece. Grab anything useful, pocket whatever you can carry, and call it a "bonus" for all that unpaid overtime.

apps.name: 底色
apps.short_description: This title is an interactive narrative game set in an urban elite‑family backdrop, where a grand tale of revenge and political intrigue spanning three corporations unfolds.

apps.name: 无尽之路
apps.short_description: 无尽之路是一克游戏品牌推出的无尽系列的开山之作，该款为横版闯关游戏，进入游戏后玩家需要用“W,S,A,D键”控制主角的“上,下,左,右”，L键为攻击键，K键为奔跑，J键为跳跃，与宠物猫对话即可切换主角(莱斯德·金)，与宠物狗对话即可切换主角(埃·金)，ent回车键为交互键进行人物的对话和事件的发生，ESC为菜单栏键，游戏里还有商店功能，与商人对话即可进入商店页面，初始默认男主为埃·金，使用枪手闯关更为容易。
publishers: 中国一克集团股份有限公司

apps.name: 桂冠之人 Laureate
apps.short_description: “世间仅此一件的视觉小说，一件没什么用，却又独一无二的艺术品。”

apps.name: 桌面仙尊
apps.short_description: An idle cultivation game that lives in the corner of your desktop. Meditate for Qi, break through realms by hand, hunt monsters for gear, and keep cultivating after you close the window.

apps.name: 此命无名
apps.short_description: Follow a bamboo path into a shared temple. Sweep leaves, meditate, strike a wooden fish, or count prayer beads. Earn incense and wish slips through practice, then light a stick or write a wish by hand as other players pass through the courtyard.

apps.name: 紅蜘蛛2/Red Spider2 リマスター版 制作応援 ver.
apps.short_description: A cinematic Hong Kong Noir visual novel. In 2007, an assassin defies orders to kill her savior and becomes a fugitive. Explore her fate through 1,300+ visual cuts and 6 branching routes.(Full story is free via the demo version. This paid edition supports Steam Achievements and the creators.)

apps.name: 阿可与小白：大战污染兽
apps.short_description: Brick-building auto-battle Roguelite. Pick a character, explore random labyrinths, collect Combat Bricks to boost stats and Legendary Bricks with special effects.
